decisions.reason: The join-confirmation title is natural and within the dialog-title budget despite the automatic width flag.
For a fixed leader-change action, 'Đổi' is the natural compact UI verb and preserves the established 'Trưởng CLB' role.
Polite filler is unnecessary in a compact input prompt; the direct instruction preserves the required action.
The relative-year label is natural, preserves {0}, and already fits the tiny-label budget.
The relative-day label is the natural Vietnamese form and preserves {0}; the small heuristic overage does not justify a less clear rewrite.
The relative-minute label is natural and preserves {0}; no safer shorter form is needed for the marginal width excess.
The zero-minute relative-time label is consistent with the neighboring minute format and is only marginally over the tiny-label heuristic.
The club-information label is clear, canonical, and essentially at the documented tab/header budget.
The member label is natural and comfortably compact.
The repository's reviewed role spelling uses lowercase 'trưởng' in 'Phó trưởng CLB'; this fixes the inconsistent capitalization without expanding the label.
As a compact member-list field, 'Đăng nhập cuối' preserves the last-login meaning while avoiding the over-wide full phrase.
The count context is inherent in a total field, so dropping 'số' keeps the total-fan meaning while reducing width.
The previous-month label is the natural compact Vietnamese form; the heuristic excess is negligible.
The compact access-condition wording preserves invitation-only membership and removes the wider instrumental phrase.
This profile tag means newcomers are welcome; 'Đón người mới' keeps that meaning with substantially less width.
The casual-play profile tag is natural and already at the pill/header budget; shortening it would risk changing the intended play-style nuance.
The daily-login requirement is clear and natural; available shorter forms would be less idiomatic without stronger layout evidence.
For a compact activity-frequency tag, the slash form conveys a two-day login cadence without the long explanatory phrase.
In a preferred-play-time tag, the tag context already supplies the 'mainly' nuance; the direct morning-play label is much more compact.
In a preferred-play-time tag, the tag context makes 'chủ yếu' redundant; the direct daytime-play label preserves the operational meaning with less width.
